attempted_claim: Fix l_L,l_R,b>0 and put a=l_L+l_R. For L>=1, let Q^L be a free Boltzmann quadrangulation with two simple boundaries of outer perimeter floor(aL) and inner perimeter floor(bL), with marked oriented outer edges e^L,e^L_* separating outer arcs of lengths floor(l_L L), floor(l_R L). Decorate Q^L by critical face percolation (p=3/4) with l_L-white/l_R-black Dobrushin boundary conditions on the outer boundary and monochromatic boundary condition on the inner boundary, and let eta^L be the percolation exploration path from e^L to e^L_*. Equip Q^L with rescaled graph metric, rescaled degree-biased area measure, rescaled outer/inner boundary paths, and eta^L under quantum-natural-time scaling. Does (Q^L, metric, area, outer path, inner path, eta^L) converge in law as L->infinity in the Gromov-Hausdorff-Prokhorov-uniform topology to the fixed-perimeter free-area Brownian annulus of perimeters (a,b) decorated by chordal SLE_6 on an independent sqrt(8/3)-Liouville quantum gravity annulus with quantum natural time? This is an asymptotic in-law unconditional Boltzmann statement with fixed asymptotic perimeters, not a finite-L identity and not conditioned on a crossing event.
decisive_failure: No component of the joint convergence was proved: neither the undecorated annular GHPU limit, nor curve tightness, nor SLE6 identification, nor the quantum-natural-time parametrization. The obstruction analysis is triage evidence only and does not substitute for any of these theorems.
